about_short_description.short_description: Guardant Health is a precision oncology company that uses blood tests, data sets, and analytics to provide treatment to cancer patients.

product.name: Guardant Complete® Portfolio
product.description: A portfolio of blood- and tissue-based oncology tests that provides genomic and molecular insights for cancer treatment selection, recurrence monitoring, and therapy-response assessment.

product.name: Shield™ Blood Test
product.description: A blood-based screening test for colorectal cancer intended to provide a more convenient screening option by analyzing cancer-related signals in blood.

product.name: Guardant Infinity™
product.description: A multiomic technology platform combining genomic, epigenomic, and RNA-based fusion data for liquid and tissue profiling, minimal residual disease detection, and response monitoring.

product.name: Biopharma Solutions
product.description: Precision-oncology services for biopharmaceutical companies, including translational research and the use of blood-based genomic data to support drug development.

product.name: InfinityAI
product.description: An artificial intelligence offering from Guardant Health intended to use oncology data and analytics to generate insights for cancer screening, diagnosis, treatment, or research.

product.name: Guardant Access Program
product.description: A billing and financial-assistance support service that helps providers and patients manage payment processes and reduce unexpected out-of-pocket costs for genomic testing.
